correctness.rationale: Inspected exact joint tagged-block law: if tags share a block choose x−2 others then S(n−x,k−1), else independently choose x−1 and y−1 others then S(n−x−y,k−2). Indicator collapse yields a=S(n−1,k)/S(n,k), b=S(n−2,k)/S(n,k) and covariance a+n(n−2)b−(n−1)²a² (one squared pair indicator). Elementary k=2 factor F_n=2^(n−1)−n(n−2)−2 changes sign at n=6 and obeys F_(n+1)−2F_n=(n−1)(n−3). k=n−1 exactly one doubleton gives negative covariance. Independent exhaustive RGS enumeration n=2..8 matched every joint cell and rational covariance; fixed-k surjective-box conditioning proves limit (k−1)/k² with O_k(n²(1−1/k)^n).

value.rationale: Size dependence of two labeled clusters is a canonical natural statistic of finite random partitions. Exact joint distribution, sharp n=6 sign crossover under two versus n−1 blocks, and fixed-k limit give a genuine dependence classification, not a table of Stirling numbers.

final_claim: For uniform k-block partitions, exact two-tag joint law and covariance, sharp k=2 n=6 sign crossover against k=n−1 negative dependence, and fixed-k covariance limit (k−1)/k².
limitations: Uniform unlabeled partitions with fixed k only; no general Gibbs/Ewens partitions or complete sign classification for all intermediate k.
